sentences.text:
Shailu Alias Shailendra Bhadoriya vs The State Of Madhya
Pradesh on 12 July, 2024

Author: Anand Pathak
Bench: Anand Pathak

1 Mcrc-27014-2024
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Anand Pathak
 On The 12 th Of July, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 27014 of 2024
 Shailu Alias Shailendra Bhadoriya
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
Appearance:
 Shri Ravindra Sigh Kushwaha, learned counsel for the petitioner.
 Shri Rajeev Upadhyay, learned Government Advocate for responden No.1/State.
 Shri Ajit Bhadoriya, learned counsel for respondent No.2/Complainant.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
The present petition is preferred under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.by the petitioner for quashment of FIR registered at Crime No.312/2024 lodged at Police Station, Dehat District Bhind for alleged offence under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 354(b) and 506 of IPC and Section 66(e), 67,67(a) of Information and Technology Act.
2. Leaned counsel for the petitioner pressed for quashment of FIR on the basis of settlement between the parties.

3. Said contention is opposed by the Government Advocate on the ground that case is under Investigation and looking to the nature of allegations which are implicative in nature, settlement cannot be done.
4. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks withdrawal of this petition to pursue his other remedies as available to him in investigation/trial.
6. Petition stands dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as aforesaid.
